title: Customer Care Desk Treadwear Adjustment Credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Treadwear adjustment credit at the customer care desk — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

The customer care desk works out and issues the treadwear adjustment credit for one worn wheel position of an active Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set on a vehicle whose usage class is personal, from the set's records. A set on a vehicle whose usage class is commercial is adjusted under the treadwear adjustment terms alone. The credit is issued on the set and is used toward replacement tires under the adjustment credit terms.

### Capability
`issue_treadwear_adjustment_f769c805` issues a prorated treadwear adjustment credit on one wheel position of a customer's Crestline tire set, processed by the customer care desk. One call books one adjustment entry for the position, citing the tread inspection it rests on and carrying that inspection's odometer, the store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date, the miles driven, the granted percentage and the credit amount; the credit amount is added to the adjustment credit available on the set. Once booked, the set shows the higher credit balance and the history shows the new adjustment entry.

### Invocation
The tool is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `issue_treadwear_adjustment_f769c805` and then calls it.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `tire_set_id` | reference number of the tire set the credit is issued on, as returned by the tire set lookup | id |
| `source_tire_event_id` | reference number of the tread inspection entry the adjustment rests on, as returned by the tire activity history lookup | id |
| `tire_position` | wheel position adjusted | enum: `LF` left front, `RF` right front, `LR` left rear, `RR` right rear, `SP` a matching full-size spare that is part of the set; `ALL` is never an adjusted position and applies only to whole-set services |
| `current_selling_price` | the store's selling price of the same tire on the adjustment date | USD, 2 decimal places |
| `miles_driven` | miles the adjusted tire has run | integer miles |
| `credit_pct` | adjustment percentage granted | integer percent 0-100 |
| `amount` | credit issued on the set for this position | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |

### Return
A receipt with `tire_event_id` (reference number of the new adjustment entry), `tire_set_id`, `tire_position`, `credit_pct`, `amount` (USD credit issued) and `adjustment_credit_balance` (USD credit available on the set after the entry). A returned `tire_event_id` means the adjustment was booked.

**Illustration (hypothetical values):** a call for position `LR` with `amount` 25.50 on a set holding no earlier credit returns `adjustment_credit_balance` 25.50.
